items.prompt: With seen={A} and last=5, record B,X,B,1,1,4 is rejected as OUT_OF_ORDER. What state must the next record see?

options.why: Rejected records must not reserve B. This would incorrectly reject a later valid B as a duplicate.
An older rejected timestamp must not move the accepted-time boundary backwards.
Rejection changes none of the accepted-ID, timestamp, count or notional state.
This applies both state updates before acceptance, violating the valid-only commit rule.
